description: This file implements a GUI application for creating and editing behavior coding maps in the BORIS software. It includes classes and methods for loading images, defining polygonal behavior areas, editing their properties, and saving/loading maps in JSON format.

classes.name: BehaviorsMapCreatorWindow
classes.description: Main window class for creating and editing behavior maps, including methods for loading images, drawing polygons, editing properties, and saving maps.

classes.name: BehaviorsMapCreatorWindow.View
classes.description: Custom QGraphicsView subclass handling mouse press events for polygon drawing.

methods.name: behaviors_coding_map_creator
methods.description: Function to instantiate and show the behavior coding map creator window, ensuring a project is open.
